citation.title: Strengthening of arched masonry structures with composite materials
citation.container: PhD thesis, School of Engineering, University of Minho

document.accessNote: Full thesis PDF retrieved from the University of Minho repository on 2026-08-16.

extractionNotes: Primary dataset of the twelve half-scaled arch tests published in Oliveira et al. 2010.

Table 6.5 of the thesis gives the per-specimen experimental peak loads and the authors' numerical peak loads; these exact values are recorded in sources/oliveira-2010.json with their thesis locations.

Chapter 3 of the thesis contains the FRP-masonry bond characterization (single-lap shear and pull-off tests); bond data not yet transcribed in this iteration and must be extracted before Tier A/B bond-parameter choices are finalized.
Masonry type 2 characterization (Table 4.2): compressive strength 9.1 MPa average (COV 15.7%), elastic modulus 2.04 GPa average (COV 33.9%).
